title: Bilateral arm/wrist kinematic and ownership screening
scope: Deterministic bilateral mapper-input reconstruction plus project IK and ownership audit. No Isaac dynamics, collision/contact simulation, transport, rendering, DDS, or hardware channel is opened.

frames.compatibility: Legacy wrist-joint-origin endpoint required by the immutable T002/T003 source records.

execution_failure_if: a declared source record is missing or malformed
the left/right arm ownership sets overlap or touch lower-body ownership
required evidence or provenance files are missing
two deterministic evaluations disagree beyond repeatability_tolerance_rad
scientific_failure_if: either arm fails to converge at any simultaneous step
either solved arm is clamped at a joint limit
validity.kinematic_screen_pass_rule: every simultaneous step converges, no solved joint is clamped, and bilateral arm ownership is disjoint and complete; this does not establish collision clearance or dynamic tracking

limitations.collision_reason: The R1 USD self-collision defect mechanically blocks functional arm tracking when self collisions are enabled. Functional dynamic runs disable self collisions, so they cannot establish contact/collision clearance.
limitations.endpoint_separation_metric: Wrist-endpoint Euclidean separation is reported as a kinematic diagnostic only; it is not a geometry-to-geometry clearance or collision metric.
limitations.video: not applicable to this kinematic runner; a future physics-valid collision experiment needs its own evidence including video and contact events.

cases.description: Both arms traverse the recorded T003-A move waypoints simultaneously; the left source is the declared Y-mirror of the recorded right source.
Both arms use declared T003-A waypoints but do not move symmetrically, exercising independent continuous seeds and wrist-roll commands.
Both endpoints approach the torso midline using values from T002's declared grid. This is an inward approach, not a collision test.
